reviews.t: It's all natural and organic!! Looks natural too!!
reviews.x: Best organic dye ever! Glad I found this product getting ready to order more and thought I'd let you know how great this dye is.  I used it for my hair and beard and body hair too!  I apply the organic base for the full time of 30min then rinse and dry then apply the dye for 30min! Worked great! My beard took 2 rounds ofbthe above process to completely get my white chin hair brown again and I love it! I reapply once every 2 weeks or so or when I trim up!  You can't go wrong with the grizz!!

reviews.t: I'm glad I gave this product a shot!
reviews.x: After reading the reviews, I was a little nervous about trying this and dying my beard green, but I'm glad I gave this a shot. Unlike some of the folks that used this product, I followed the instructions to the letter and also made sure to use the base first. I applied the base and let it sit the full 30 min. This works exactly as advertised.  I'd started with the [[ASIN:B00T0HZDF6 Organic & Natural Dark Brown Beard Dye]], but noticed that I'd started to turn a little pinkish-purple around the edges of my beard after a week or two (note: most hand cleaners and lotions contain alcohol, so they'll start to tinge your coloring).  I had to double the portions to really coat my beard, but the end result was just what I wanted.  The purple tinge was replaced by a much more natural looking dark brown.

Great product.  Does what it says.  Use this and the Dark Brown to get the right color for me.  Moved to these products after using a similar Henna-based product that required more time for application and less successful color results.

reviews.t: I like it much better than Henna Dye
reviews.x: I like it much better than Henna Dye. It last longer. The color don't fade like Henna. And you don't have to leave in your hair as long as Henna also.

reviews.t: I'll be using a better beard dye — this stuff just didn't work well for me
reviews.x: Honestly, it didn't work all that well for me.  On one hand I didn't have the permanent green beard experience that others had with this product (and yeah, it does turn your beard green for a bit, but it does oxidize and eventually fade out), but on the other it didn't work all that well for me.  Full disclosure: I've got mild alopecia and when my facial hair comes back it comes back white.  This product did not do a very good job of dying my beard AND it didn't last as long as others have said.

I used this prior to using the beard dye as recommended. However, my review for that is...  This didn't perform well for me. I have thick, 90%, grey beard hair and wanted something simple for dying stubble type beard. This didn't work so well and the color was not natural. In fact, I've used another product for a long time and no one was even the wiser. After using this, someone asked me if I dye my beard! It's a pain to mix, apply, wait and rinse(wash) off.  Upon first use, I did get a green ti

Moved to this option as does not stain skin. Personally, I only need the base product to get me back to my natural color. Tip: I would recommend leaving base on for ~30 min, and it will take 6-8 hours after you wash out base for it to fully change to base color. Best to do procedure at night.  Will be go to go in the morning.

I tried just for men and others, but it made me break out in hives and blisters. Grizzly Mountain takes longer, 30 min but it doesn't irritate my face at all!!  Also I have a ginger beard with very coarse hair, I dye it brown and it works fantastic! looks really natural. one pack lasts well over a month while applying weekly.

reviews.t: chemical free venture has not been the best experience so far
reviews.x: I guess this helped, but this whole organic, chemical free venture has not been the best experience so far. I ordered the dark brown. The colors are much lighter than I realized, and do not cover greys like I thought it would.
Didn't give my husband burns like the Just for Men did which is definitely a good thing. It just didn't last as long and definitely gave a purple tint to his beard which took forever to grow out.

Didn’t feel like it worked very well for me. Turned my lighter beard colors a orangish color instead of a light brown. Didn’t work nearly as well as chemical dyes.

reviews.t: Pretty good overall compared to harsh chemicals....
reviews.x: But the light brown turns my grey to a reddish color and the rest fades to a reddish color.  I'm going to try black for the salt/pepper look without the red.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product works well and delivers natural-looking color, especially when the base is used before the dye.
Several reviewers highlight that it is a good option for people with allergies or sensitive skin, unlike commercial dyes.
A few reviewers report disappointing results, including poor gray coverage or unnatural color, particularly with thick or stubborn gray hair.
Some reviewers note that following the instructions and using the base first is important to avoid problems like a green tint.
A few reviewers mention that the color fades or requires frequent reapplication.
